name: tracearr
description: Query Tracearr's public API for media tracing and analytics. Skills-only, no MCP server required.
author: Jacob Magar

settings.name: Tracearr URL
settings.description: Tracearr base URL for its public API, e.g. http://localhost:3000 (no trailing slash).

settings.name: Tracearr API key
settings.description: Bearer token for the Tracearr API. Optional — omit if your Tracearr exposes its public API unauthenticated.
